ROOT.scriptdef: if exists(SELECT name from sysobjects where name='ProdDomyslnyPTZDlaTwr' and type='FN') drop function CDN.ProdDomyslnyPTZDlaTwr

CREATE FUNCTION [CDN].[ProdDomyslnyPTZDlaTwr] (@TechId INT,@TwrNumer INT) RETURNS INT AS BEGIN
RETURN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(POW.PTZ_Id,0) = 0 then Z.PTZ_Id else null end),MAX(Z.PTZ_Id),0) FROM CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby Z JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci C ON C.PTC_Id = Z.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc LEFT JOIN CDN.ProdTechnologiaZasoby POW ON Z.PTZ_Id = POW.PTZ_TechnologiaZasob AND C.PTC_Technologia = (SELECT PTC_Technologia FROM CDN.ProdTechnologiaCzynnosci WHERE PTC_Id = POW.PTZ_TechnologiaCzynnosc) WHERE C.PTC_Technologia = @TechId AND Z.PTZ_TwrNumer = @TwrNumer AND Z.PTZ_TypZasobu = 0) END
GRANT EXEC ON CDN.ProdDomyslnyPTZDlaTwr TO CDNRaport
